Title: Relates to adopting the standards of the International code council for the design, fabrication and assembly of factory manufactured homes
Summary: Directs the uniform fire prevention and building code to adopt the International Code Council (ICC)/MBI 1200-2021 Standard for Off-site Construction: Planning, Design, Fabrication and Assembly, ICC/MBI 1205-2021 Standard for Off-site Construction, and ICC/MBI 1210-2023 Standard for Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing Systems, Energy Efficiency and Water Conservation in Off-site Construction: Inspection and Regulatory Compliance relating to factory manufactured homes; permits third party review of factory manufactured homes.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to adopting standards of the International code council for the design, fabrication and assembly of factory manufactured homes, and in relation to third party review of factory manufactured homes
